title: betonica officinalis subsp. alpigena
intro: Betonica officinalis subsp. alpigena, commonly known as Mountain Betony, is a subspecies of the Betonica officinalis plant, which is a type of flowering plant in the mint family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestive issues, making it a popular choice for treating conditions such as irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Betony include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe pain and discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, iridoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
